providerDefault: none, so registered webhooks (if any) are used
summary: Requests completion callbacks for the long-running video operation, with optional metadata for correlating the callback to local work. It is Gemini Developer API infrastructure, not a generation-quality control.
combines: The current @google/genai converter sends webhookConfig only on the Gemini Developer API path and explicitly rejects it in Vertex mode.
Lixpi polls operations in-process today, so enabling this would require callback authentication, idempotency, and durable operation correlation rather than a matrix field.
